tasks.short: Maintain accurate and complete student records.

steps.what: Retrieve and verify actual student attendance, assessment and required record sources
Transfer actual existing attendance and assessed results into draft student record fields
inputs: actual source student, assessment and attendance identifiers

steps.what: Maintain accurate and complete student records in the student information system {OTHER}
inputs: actual teacher observations and required additional fields

steps.what: Check final student record identity, completeness and actual source accuracy
Commit the checked final actual student record

tasks.design: Configure native source views and exact-field transfer from {LMS} into draft records in the student information system {OTHER}. The teacher supplies actual additional observations, checks the complete final record and commits it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Student records can duplicate existing attendance and assessed results.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links and student/assessment mappings can remove exact re-entry.
tasks.still_hard: Correct identity, sensitive observations and required completeness need teacher checks.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher knows whether a recorded result or observation fairly reflects the actual student work.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate record entry; assessment and record responsibility stay human.

evidence.claim: The supplied digest describes ParnasSys pupil records and learning-goal tracking; this supports records capability, not a local import or savings baseline.
Model knowledge: supported exact student-field mappings can replace duplicate entry where actual identifiers match.

assumptions: Actual attendance owner and teacher-assessed sources supply student identifier, assessment/event identifier, date, value and status. Teacher verifies identity and completeness in s1; missing or ambiguous values remain manual in s3.

Teacher captures actual additional observations within retained s3; no free note production or automated grading is assumed. S3 cuts repeated student/reference entry, not interpretation or new observation capture.
School supplies actual record requirements and access scope. Native views/imports first; existing automatic records and runtime earn zero saving. No new pupil tracking or diagnosis is introduced.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Routine commit retains one percent and uses the existing final record check. Student-record work shared with other tasks is counted once.
unknowns: Which actual source fields are entered twice?
research_questions: Can draft imports reduce entry after complete identity and completeness checking?

incremental.description: Maintain actual student/source mappings and required-field settings.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final actual student record and exact student destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 25*0.40 source navigation + 30 exact transfer + 20*0.30 repeated fields = 46; minus 2 upkeep = 44. Half eligible gives 23 minus 2 = 21. Actual observation capture, final checking and commit stay retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Guide and counsel students on adjustment and academic concerns.

steps.what: Retrieve and check actual student context relevant to adjustments or academic concerns
Guide and counsel students with adjustments, academic problems or special academic interests
outputs: actual guidance and agreed next steps

steps.what: Record and check actual guidance and agreed next steps when required
inputs: actual guidance and agreed next steps
outputs: checked final actual student guidance record

steps.what: Save the checked final actual student guidance record
inputs: checked final actual student guidance record

tasks.design: Configure relevant native student-context views in the student information system {OTHER} and {LMS}. The teacher personally counsels the student and captures/checks any actual required guidance record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Counselling preparation can require repeated navigation to relevant student context.
tasks.enabler_now: Native authorised context views can shorten lookup.
tasks.still_hard: Trust, adjustment problems and appropriate support require conversation and judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher hears what the student needs and adjusts guidance accordingly.
tasks.altitude: Less support-context navigation; counselling stays personal.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native authorised student-context views can reduce navigation; they do not counsel a student.

assumptions: Actual student records and learning-opportunity information already exist; teacher verifies relevance in s1 and obtains actual needs in s2. Missing context remains manual.

Required guidance entry is split out and fully retained, with no free conversation capture. It belongs to record task 6611 in a combined estimate and is counted once. If no record is required, omit s3/s4 and reweight.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native views first; existing linked access earns zero saving. Routine save retains one percent and uses the existing final record check.
unknowns: Which guidance records are actually required?
research_questions: Can authorised native context views reduce lookup without adding student records?

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final actual guidance record and exact student destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10*0.40 navigation = 4; minus 0.5 upkeep = 3.5. Half eligible gives 2 minus 0.5 = 1.5. Counselling, record capture and save stay fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Encourage exploration and perseverance for later education.

steps.what: Retrieve and check actual later educational learning opportunities relevant to students
inputs: actual student interests and course context

steps.what: Encourage students to explore learning opportunities and persevere with challenging tasks

tasks.design: Configure native current pathway/source links in {DOCS} and {LMS}. The teacher checks relevance and personally encourages exploration and perseverance during actual learning.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant opportunity information may require repeated source navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native current source links can shorten that lookup.
tasks.still_hard: Motivation and support through difficulty require a teacher's relationship and observation.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher knows when to challenge, reassure or offer a different route.
tasks.altitude: Less opportunity lookup; encouragement stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native pathway/source links can support opportunity lookup; they do not replace encouragement or establish student motivation.

assumptions: Actual pathway information owner supplies current opportunities; teacher verifies relevance in s1. Student interest and effort are actual teacher/student context, not inferred scores.
Boundary is lookup and actual encouragement. No separate report, record write or digital send is specified; any actual required student note is handled once under task 6611 with capture retained.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Only repeated lookup is eligible; no preparation allowance per conversation if sources were prepared once per course. Existing links earn zero saving.
unknowns: How often is source lookup actually needed?
research_questions: Can native links reduce actual repeated lookup without creating administration?

incremental.description: Keep actual pathway source links current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10*0.40 actual repeated lookup = 4; minus 0.5 upkeep = 3.5. Half eligible gives 2 minus 0.5 = 1.5. Encouragement remains fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan and conduct balanced technical-learning activities.

steps.what: Choose actual instruction, demonstration and work-time goals and safety constraints
inputs: actual workshop resources and safety constraints
outputs: actual chosen activity goals and teaching approach

steps.what: Plan balanced activities for students to observe, question and investigate
inputs: actual chosen activity goals and teaching approach
actual teacher selected examples and resources

loop.purpose: Draft the activity sequence from actual teacher choices
loop.input: Actual goals, approach, selected examples and safe resources
loop.check: Teacher checks learning intent, age suitability, omitted observation/questioning opportunities and unsafe procedure implications
loop.stop: Missing actual teaching choice or two failed revisions returns writing to manual work
loop.why_not_simpler: Native lesson headings and resource reuse first; activity explanations and questioning sequences vary

steps.what: Check final activity plan for balance, actual resources and safe student participation
inputs: actual chosen activity goals and teaching approach

steps.what: Save the checked final technical activity plan
Conduct instruction, demonstration and work-time activities with actual students
inputs: actual student responses and workshop conditions
outputs: actual teaching, questioning and investigation activity

tasks.design: Use native lesson headings and resource reuse in {LMS} before a bounded activity-plan draft in {DOCS}. The teacher chooses goals and approach, checks the final balance and safety, saves the plan and conducts all actual teaching.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing an activity plan can repeat explanations after teaching choices are made.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded drafting from actual teacher choices can reduce first-draft writing.
tasks.still_hard: Safe demonstration, balancing student needs and responding to questions require teaching judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher adapts the activity to actual pupils and workshop conditions.
tasks.altitude: Less activity-plan writing; classroom work stays intact.

evidence.claim: The supplied digest describes lesson-editor text adaptation in LessonUp; this supports drafting capability, not local savings or safe technical instruction.

assumptions: Teacher supplies actual goals, chosen approach and safety constraints in s1, and captures selected examples/resources within retained s2. No free pedagogical choice or generated hazardous work procedure is assumed.
Draft meaning correction stays in s2 and the full final activity check in s3. Actual teaching, demonstration and student response remain fully retained.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native templates/resource reuse first; prepared plans are counted once per actual new/revised activity, not a new planning baseline for each delivery.
Routine save retains one percent and uses the existing final plan check. Any student-facing publication is a separate actual gated action, with no saving claimed here.
unknowns: How much activity-plan prose is rewritten?
research_questions: Does checked drafting reduce actual new/revised plan writing after full safety review?

already_counted.description: Correct activity-plan meaning and suitability within s2.

incremental.description: Maintain actual activity-plan drafting checks and resource references.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final technical activity plan and exact course destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 19*0.40 plan writing = 7.6; minus 1 upkeep = 6.6. Half eligible gives 3.8 minus 1 = 2.8. Teaching choices, final check, save and classroom work remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Teachers retain counselling, encouragement and teaching while actual student-field duplication and new activity-plan writing may shrink.
skills_to_grow: Technical activity-plan safety and meaning review
role.ambitious_version: Validate real repeated records and preparation, counting student notes and course preparation once.
